title: Build file
description: How a source mod's build makes the mod's folder from its source folder.

steps.description: The steps the build runs, in order.

archives.description: Each archive to pack, by its path in the mod's folder, with the paths of the loose files it packs.

task.description: The label of the VS Code user task that runs the step.

args.description: The arguments the step hands its task.

page.description: The page where the user gets the tool the task runs. Absent when the tool comes with the source folder.
